invalidAddress: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS WordPress address, including its installation folder. Do not include a username or password.
publicAddressRequired: Enter a public WordPress address. Local or private network addresses cannot be checked here.
wordpressNotFound: WordPress could not be verified at this address. Include the installation folder (for example /baneh). Check that the site's REST API is available and try again. Enter the public site address, not a custom admin login path.
discoveryTimeout: The WordPress check timed out. Check the address and try again.
alreadyAdded: This site has already been added.
certUnreadable: The certificate could not be read
incidentsEmpty: No events recorded yet. This means nothing was observed, not that the site was definitely healthy — the site is only seen when it is scanned.

incident.desc: This was seen in a scan and is still open. It will not be marked resolved until a later scan confirms it is gone.

safeModeRefused: Safe mode is on; automatic updates were not turned off.
rotateConfirm: This step signs every user out of the site. Send confirm=true to run it.
brokenUrlRequired: The broken page's URL is required.

updates.noneMatched: None of the submitted items were found in the site's update queue; fetch the update list again.
updates.needApproval: The selected items need your approval; each high-risk item must be approved and run separately.
updates.noLowRisk: There is no low-risk item in the queue; high-risk items need your separate approval.

restoreConfirm: Restoring replaces the current database with the older copy, and every change made after that backup is lost. Send confirm=true to run it.
noOffsiteTarget: No cloud backup destination (S3) is configured.
openEventNotFound: No open event with this ID was found.
notReadyToPair: The site is not ready to connect yet.
proposalSettled: This proposal has already been decided.
needsApproval: This action is sensitive and needs your approval.
simulated: Simulation — the site is not paired live.

events.mcpRan: Ran {op} from an AI client (hub MCP)

wordpressForbidden: WordPress REST access is forbidden (403). Check REST restrictions in the security plugin, WAF or host IP rules. The admin login URL is not required.
connectorAuth: The connector rejected the signature (401). Check the shared key and Hub Connector Mode in the plugin. Changing the admin login URL does not require a new key. Update the plugin to 3.9.2 or later; the connector signature changed in that version.
connectorForbidden: Connector access was refused (403). Check REST restrictions in the security plugin, firewall or hosting and allow signed requests from your relay server.
connectorMissing: Connector route not found (404). Check the public WordPress address and installation folder, and activate DigiWp Ai Bridge. Do not enter a custom login URL as the site address.
connectorRedirect: The connector redirects. Enter the final HTTPS address and canonical site domain; signed requests were not forwarded to another address.
connectorInvalid: No valid connector response (HTTP {status}). Check plugin activation, Connector Mode and login or security challenges blocking REST.
